findings.evidence: Existing precedent: `tmulConj_tmulConj` (Conjugation.lean:370) and `OrthonormalBasis.conjugation_conjugation` (Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Conjugation.lean:87) are stated as apply-twice lemmas.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem conjugationOfComplexification_conjugationOfComplexification (e) (v) : conjugationOfComplexification e (conjugationOfComplexification e v) = v`.
findings.issue: `LinearEquiv.conjugationOfComplexification` has only `_involutive`, which simp cannot use, so `conj (conj v)` has no simp normal form.

findings.evidence: `conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal_involutive` is the only involution statement in the diff.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal_conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal : f.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal hf hmax (f.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal hf hmax v) = v`.
findings.issue: Same gap for `LinearMap.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal`: only `_involutive` is provided.

findings.fix: Add `@[simp] maximalRealFormConjugationDiffeomorph_apply_apply : Φ (Φ p) = p`, or once the fibre lemma above is simp, the existing `_apply` simp lemma closes it.
findings.issue: Same gap for `maximalRealFormConjugationDiffeomorph`: only `_involutive` is provided, so simp cannot reduce Φ (Φ p) on the total space.

summary: The new conjugations each get only an `_involutive` theorem; none has an `@[simp]` lemma stating that applying it twice gives back the input, unlike the library's existing `tmulConj_tmulConj` and `conjugation_conjugation`. The rest of the surface is acceptable: bodies stay hidden, there is no compatibility layer, and the extension, uniqueness, fixed-locus and naturality API is complete.
